info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API allows clients to access a list of loyalty partners associated with the loyalty program. This endpoint serves as a valuable resource for businesses looking to enhance customer engagement through partnerships. Developers can utilize this API to integrate loyalty program information into applications, providing end-users with relevant partnership details. Typical consumers of this API include mobile app developers, marketing teams, and customer relations platforms seeking to leverage loyalty offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty program partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about various partners involved in the loyalty program. It provides details such as partner names, types, and benefits associated with each partner. Use this endpoint to build a comprehensive list of partners for display or further analysis.
